ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white/cream central pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral and mottled pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity region across both lobes. Extensive low-intensity (black) mottling and vertical streaking concentrated on the right lobe. Thick low-intensity continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips. Concentrated dark pixel cluster at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow acute angle estimated at 42 degrees; vertical depth occupies approximately 22% of visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations localized on the right lobe trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude variations. Distinct jagged 'stair-step' topography on the inner-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetric convexity; left lobe displays a continuous upward sweep, while the right lobe exhibits a multi-modal curve with a secondary protrusion before the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tip and dorsal-most trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 6-8 distinct, dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular morphology and potential tissue loss on the right lobe tip; dense clusters of ectoparasitic/barnacle scarring on distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated circular dark ring (approx. 12-pixel diameter) located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe white field.
